name: Building
when: Assembling a dashboard, report or deck

variants.name: Stack
variants.desc: Blocks drop onto a pile beside it, each one with a thud.

variants.name: Hammer
variants.desc: Hard hat on, hammering away with a spark on every hit.

variants.name: Tiles
variants.desc: Dashboard tiles pop into a grid above its head.

variants.name: Blueprint
variants.desc: A plan draws itself out on blueprint paper.

variants.name: Crane
variants.desc: Hard hat on, a crane lowers a block into its head.

parts.t: <g class="att att-hard" transform="translate(50 {{a.hat}})"><path class="hh" d="M-18 0A18 15 0 0 1 18 0Z"></path><path class="hhb" d="M-22 0H22M0 -14V-4"></path></g>

<g class="fx-blocks" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.dn}})"><g transform="translate(90 0)"><g><rect class="a blk hc" x="-7" y="71" width="14" height="10" rx="1.5"></rect><rect class="a blk gst" x="-7" y="61" width="14" height="10" rx="1.5"></rect><rect class="a blk cst" x="-7" y="51" width="14" height="10" rx="1.5"></rect></g></g></g>

<g class="fx-hammer" transform="translate({{a.side}} {{a.dn}})"><rect class="bx" x="84" y="73" width="12" height="8" rx="1.5"></rect><g transform="translate(74 62)"><g class="vb0 hm"><path d="M0 0H17" fill="none" stroke="#B98A4E" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"></path><rect class="dk" x="15.5" y="-5" width="6.5" height="10.5" rx="1.5"></rect></g></g><path class="a spk" d="M90 65V68.5M83.5 69L86 71M96.5 69L94 71" fill="none" stroke="#E89B1A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"></path></g>

<g class="fx-cards" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g><rect class="a crd pw" x="35" y="-11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"></rect><rect class="a crd gst" x="51" y="-11" width="14" height="10" rx="2"></rect><rect class="a crd hc" x="35" y="1" width="14" height="10" rx="2"></rect><rect class="a crd pw" x="51" y="1" width="14" height="10" rx="2"></rect></g></g>

<g class="fx-blueprint" transform="translate(0 {{a.dn}})"><g transform="translate(50 78)"><rect class="bp" x="-17" y="-11" width="34" height="22" rx="2"></rect><path d="M-14 -5H14M-14 1H14M-14 7H14M-9 -10V10M0 -10V10M9 -10V10" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".18" stroke-width=".8"></path><path class="bpl" d="M-9 8V0L0 -7L9 0V8ZM-2.5 8V2.5H2.5V8"></path></g></g>

<g class="fx-crane" transform="translate(0 {{a.up}})"><g transform="translate(50 0)"><g class="a hook"><path class="wire" d="M0 -18V1"></path><circle cx="0" cy="3" r="2" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8" style="stroke: var(--aa-ink, #3A3833)"></circle><path class="wire" d="M-6 6L0 4.5L6 6"></path></g><g class="a cblk"><rect class="gst" x="-7" y="6" width="14" height="9" rx="1.5"></rect></g></g></g>
